title: IDP AutoOpt: Agent-Driven Optimization of Document Processing Pipeline Configurations
abstract: arXiv:2607.26075v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present IDP AutoOpt, an autonomous LLM agent that discovers high-performing configurations for intelligent document processing (IDP) pipelines. Tuning IDP prompts, models, OCR settings, and schemas jointly currently costs domain specialists 20 to 80+ person-hours per document type and does not scale as enterprises add document classes. IDP AutoOpt runs a closed loop: it scores a configuration on a small labeled set, diagnoses field-level errors, generates targeted edits, and re-evaluates, guided by human-authored domain skills that encode production expertise. Across extraction, classification, and packet-splitting tasks deployed in healthcare, marketing-intelligence, and financial-services settings, IDP AutoOpt matches or exceeds human-expert accuracy at equal or lower cost (on an extraction benchmark, 90.2% vs 81.6% at 4.6 x lower per-page cost), cutting configuration time from weeks to under two hours. translated_title: IDP AutoOpt：智能文档处理流水线配置的代理驱动优化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了IDP AutoOpt，一个自主的LLM代理，用于发现智能文档处理（IDP）流水线的高性能配置。当前，联合调整IDP提示、模型、OCR设置和模式，每个文档类型需要领域专家20到80以上的人工小时，并且随着企业增加文档类别而无法扩展。IDP AutoOpt运行一个闭环：它在一个小标注集上对配置进行评分，诊断字段级错误，生成有针对性的编辑，并重新评估，由编码生产专业知识的人工编写的领域技能引导。在医疗保健、市场情报和金融服务环境中部署的提取、分类和分组任务中，IDP AutoOpt在相同或更低的成本下匹配或超过人类专家的准确性（在提取基准上，90.2%对比81.6%，每页成本低4.6倍），将配置时间从数周缩短到两小时以下。我们还进一步展示了...
tldr: IDP AutoOpt通过闭环LLM代理自动优化文档处理流水线配置，在降低成本的同时匹配或超越人类专家准确性，并将配置时间从数周缩短到两小时以下。
en_tdlr: IDP AutoOpt automates optimization of document processing pipeline configurations via a closed-loop LLM agent, matching or exceeding human-expert accuracy at lower cost and reducing configuration time from weeks to under two hours.
